entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-88210-5.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. To proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It just doesn't work for me.
I see. So, the device powers on and connects, but it's just not the right fit for your workout style?
Whatever. I just don't want it anymore.

Understood. I'm just looking at the delivery date here, which was 42 days ago. I'll need to review our return **policy**. For some of our wearable items, due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons, it can be **too late** to process a return after a certain period. Let me just confirm the specific window for the Cadence Sensor.
Okay, thanks for your patience... It looks like you're in luck. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 10-day return policy, so we can definitely process this for you.
Fine. So you're actually going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I have just initiated the return, and I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
About time. You made that sound like a big deal.
My apologies, I just have to be thorough when checking our policies. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
